blocks.text: Reigning Miss Grand International Emma Tiglao has now joined the ranks of 2013 Miss World Megan Young, 2016 Miss International Kylie Verzosa and 2015 Miss Universe Pia Wurtzbach, not only because she has brought home an international pageant title, but also because she now also has a shoe named after her. The Kapampangan broadcaster, the second Filipino woman to receive the “golden crown” of the Miss Grand International pageant, is the muse for the latest Jojo Bragais pageant shoe called “Emma.” “I felt very honored because I know Jojo doesn’t just create shoes, he creates pieces with stories behind them.
